tool_signatures.name: Delete Fix Item
tool_signatures.description: Permanently remove one entry. Fix items are hand-authored and are not regenerated by re-auditing.

tool_signatures.name: Delete Site Audit
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete an audit and all of its results. Cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: Discover Site URLs
tool_signatures.description: Crawl a domain (sitemap + link discovery) and return every page found, grouped by depth, along with your remaining monthly audit quota.

tool_signatures.name: Email Site Audit Report
tool_signatures.description: Email the report with PDF attachments to the authenticated account's own address. Sends real email on every call and is not idempotent; the recipient cannot be chosen.

tool_signatures.name: Export Fix Items CSV
tool_signatures.description: The fix list as CSV text for handoff. PDF export is available in the dashboard only.

tool_signatures.name: Export Image Asset
tool_signatures.description: Export generated image assets as inline base64, with optional disk write when running locally

tool_signatures.name: Generate Image
tool_signatures.description: Create professional images: illustrations, diagrams (Mermaid/D2/Vega), icons, social cards, or QR codes

tool_signatures.name: Get Connection Context
tool_signatures.description: Which organization this connection acts for, and which Site Audit features its plan allows. The organization is chosen during authorization and is what every tool defaults to.

tool_signatures.name: Get Link Preview
tool_signatures.description: Instant, synchronous check of how a URL will render when shared — returns Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and Google preview cards plus a quality score and fix list. Does not consume audit quota.

tool_signatures.name: Get Monitoring Schedule
tool_signatures.description: A website's recurring-audit settings: frequency, anchored day and time, paused state, next run.

tool_signatures.name: Get OG Data
tool_signatures.description: /api/3.0/site/<URL>

tool_signatures.name: Get OG Extract
tool_signatures.description: /api/1.1/extract/<URL>

tool_signatures.name: Get OG Markdown
tool_signatures.description: /api/3.0/markdown/<URL>

tool_signatures.name: Get OG Query
tool_signatures.description: /api/1.1/query/<URL>

tool_signatures.name: Get OG Scrape Data
tool_signatures.description: /api/3.0/scrape/<URL>

tool_signatures.name: Get OG Screenshot
tool_signatures.description: /api/3.0/screenshot/<URL>

tool_signatures.name: Get Site Audit Changes
tool_signatures.description: What changed since the previous run — new, fixed, and regressed issues, pages added or removed, and the score delta — plus prioritized issue groups. A regressed issue is one previously verified as fixed that has come back; this is tracked across runs by durable issue identity, not by diffing two lists.

tool_signatures.name: Get Site Audit Report
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve the full report once complete: overall score (0–100), an AI-generated executive summary, prioritized fixes, per-page scores, and Open Graph coverage rates.

tool_signatures.name: Get Site Audit Status
tool_signatures.description: Poll an in-progress audit (QUEUED → CRAWLING → SCORING → COMPLETE).

tool_signatures.name: Inspect Image Session
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve session metadata and asset history for image generation sessions

tool_signatures.name: Iterate Image
tool_signatures.description: Refine, modify, or create variations of existing generated images

tool_signatures.name: List Fix Items
tool_signatures.description: Proposed metadata changes and notes saved against an audit, grouped by page, each with an ID.

tool_signatures.name: List Site Audits
tool_signatures.description: Past audits, newest first, filterable by domain, status, date range, or website.

tool_signatures.name: List Websites
tool_signatures.description: Every site the organization has audited, with current score and trend against the previous run, critical issue and regression counts, known page count, and next scheduled run. Pass a websiteId for one in detail.

tool_signatures.name: Preview Page Audit
tool_signatures.description: Instant, synchronous single-URL quality check with score + issues. Does not consume audit quota.

tool_signatures.name: Save Fix Items
tool_signatures.description: Record proposed changes for one page. Overwrites existing items for the same page and field. A blank or unchanged proposedValue is rejected — it means "remove" upstream, so use Delete Fix Item deliberately.

tool_signatures.name: Set Monitoring Schedule
tool_signatures.description: Enable, change, or remove recurring audits. Commits ongoing page-quota spend and can trigger alert email. enabled: false deletes the configuration — use paused: true to keep it. Alert recipients are dashboard-only.

tool_signatures.name: Start Site Audit
tool_signatures.description: Kick off an async, multi-page SEO/social audit. Pass an explicit urls[] list (from discovery, a sitemap, or a codebase route scan) or let the backend crawl the domain itself. Returns an auditId immediately.
